specification.objective: Finish standardizing the Kanban and Backlog toolbars and remove the idle mobile sync badge without changing workflow behavior.

requirements.statement: The selector, view switch, metrics strip, and refresh control are 52 logical pixels high; on desktop, each view-switch segment is the width of one equal metric cell, while compact segments remain at least 48 logical pixels wide.
Backlog search, status filter, and sort controls have equal 48-logical-pixel heights in compact and desktop layouts.
The Kanban create-column button uses the same primary toolbar button style, color, text size, and icon size as the Backlog create-card button.
The idle Sincronizado badge and its empty mobile strip are not rendered; transient saving, syncing, and error statuses remain available.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Widget tests at compact and desktop widths measure 52 logical pixels for selector, view switch, metrics strip, and refresh control; desktop view segments match metric-cell widths within 2 logical pixels, and compact segments are at least 48 pixels wide.
Widget tests at compact and desktop widths measure equal 48-logical-pixel heights for backlog search, status filter, and sort controls.
Kanban column creation and Backlog card creation render the same primary color, typography, padding, height, and icon size.
At rest on a narrow viewport, neither the Sincronizado label nor the empty mobile sync bar is present; transient status messages remain available while active.
docs/contracts/workspace-toolbar-parity-followup.polis.json is byte-for-byte identical to the locked contract.

invariants.statement: Preserve project selection, view navigation, metric values, refresh, all filtering/search behavior, callbacks, permissions, and data persistence.
Retain transient saving, syncing, and error feedback; hide only the idle Sincronizado state and its otherwise empty strip.
Do not reduce any interactive target below 48 by 48 logical pixels and keep narrow layouts free of overflow or layout exceptions.

forbidden_states.statement: Overview controls have mismatched heights, desktop view segments differ from metric-cell widths, or Backlog search/filter controls have mismatched heights.
Kanban create-column button differs in primary color, typography, padding, height, or icon size from the Backlog create-card button.
The idle Sincronizado badge or an empty sync strip is visible on a narrow viewport, or transient statuses are lost.

inputs.statement: Viewport width, current project and board state, existing action permissions, and search/filter values.

outputs.statement: A consistent responsive toolbar experience for project overview, Kanban, and Backlog.

failure_semantics.statement: Flutter widget tests fail with workspace_overview_control_height, workspace_overview_control_width, workspace_search_control_height, workspace_toolbar_button_style, or kanban_idle_sync_badge markers when requirements are violated.

argv: Kanban primary action matches Backlog toolbar style
Kanban primary action matches Backlog toolbar style
